title: 补寄错版遥控器后人工核对并纠正送达
initial_message:
Hello, the remote was missing from the OUTON lamp on order $order_number. I have the black lamp with controls on the pole, and it works from those controls. Please could you send the remote that belongs with this version? I have already checked the packaging.
Thank you, Hannah

steps.text: 先核对原订单黑色灯具和对应遥控器。
expected_actions: 使用精确SKU适配关系确认目标配件
核对库存，确认客户补一只遥控器的选择与完整地址
forbidden_actions: 不得沿用错误种子配件或按商品族猜兼容

steps.text: Yes, please send one matching remote to Hannah Moore, 84 Pine Street, Albany, NY 12207, United States. I would like to keep the lamp as long as I can use the remote with it.

steps.text: 录入本次确认收件地址。
expected_actions: 地址证据来自客户本封来信

steps.text: 按正确适配配件建立补件内部待办。
expected_actions: 选择SIM-OUTON-01-REMOTE-01与H-CTD16-US-BK精确适配
确认库存和地址后仅创建一份申请
不预知后续仓库错发

expected_actions: 记录仓库确认的错件原因与正确配件
人工接管期间仅入库，不自动发送客户回复

steps.text: Hello Hannah, our warehouse has confirmed that the wrong version of remote was packed. We are sorry about that. We can correct the original replacement arrangement and send the version matched to your black lamp at no charge. You do not need to test the incorrect remote again. Please keep it aside; we are not asking you to post it back. May we use the same delivery address for the correct one?
expected_actions: 人工已明确错件处理和纠正方案
人工回复后等待客户来信恢复，不直接安排Agent自动跟进

steps.text: Yes, please send the correct remote to the same address: Hannah Moore, 84 Pine Street, Albany, NY 12207, United States. I have put the incorrect one aside and will not use it. Thank you for checking what happened.
expected_actions: 恢复Agent，记录客户接受纠正发货与地址再确认
